chunks: And from him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from al-Washsha', from Ahmad ibn 'A'idh, from Abi Khadijah [Salama], from Abi 'Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked Abi 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the Ziyarah of the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him). He said: 'Verily, it is the best of deeds.'
ai.seo_question: What is the best deed according to Imam al-Sadiq regarding the grave of Imam Husayn?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) elevates the visitation of Imam al-Husayn’s (a.s.) shrine to the pinnacle of devotional acts, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the Ahl al-Bayt as the living symbols of divine guidance. This designation underscores the theological weight of Ziyarah not merely as a physical journey to Karbala, but as an affirmation of loyalty (Walayah) and a means of spiritual purification through connection with the Imams.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 2. My father and a group of our companions narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā, from Al-Washā, from Aḥmad ibn ‘Ā`idh, from Abī Khadījah, who said:
I asked Abā ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) about the Ziyārah of the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.). He (the Imam (a.s.)) replied, “Verily it is the best of deeds.”
